body: I was Banned By Javipepe For Hacking: Fly, FastLadder, No Fall on February 19 2016. I deleted all of my hacks because it takes away from the main point of the game which is have fun and win. And I didn't want hacks to get in the way of that so I've waited 4-5 months then i sent this I'm hoping i can get back onto advices because it is really fun and I like the server a lot. @Javipepe @Jiveh @ all staff

title: Appeal request for xXitz_NickXx

replies.author: Javipepe
replies.body:
Hello Nick,

Due to the time you have waited I will give you a second chance. However if you break our rules again your possibility of appeal will be close to non-existant. Please take a moment to read our rules again and ensure you never breach them. Please don't let me down here, I'm trusting you.

Regards,
Javi
